about: Painted features on the walls of RA-B-1 (AI-generated, sheet RA-B's step-1 picture), the kit's fixed obstacles for the Lead's 15 px rule (version 2). Picture pixels of the 1024 x 1536 painting; a polygon holds the pixels whose centres lie inside it. Each outline was read from RA-B-1 at 4 times on a 10 px grid, its dark ink outline and any contact shadow included, and drawn a little generous. Structural lines the guide itself draws (the kick strips, the deck seams, the corners) are not features, as in view A. Where Vega's desk or Atlas's crates stand in front of a painted feature, their outline must cross it: those crossings are named exceptions, each with its zone, for the Lead's decision.

picture.name: RA-B-1
picture.readOn: ra-B-1-dim.png (RA-B-1 with two cells in each junction box dimmed in code; the outlines are the same)

rule: Every step-2 mask edge either clearly overlaps a feature in the test, covering it with at least 15 px to spare, or clears it by at least 15 px (square pixels): no part of the feature lies within 15 px of a mask edge. A named exception, for the Lead's decision, passes only where every such part lies in its zone. The features not in the test are measured and reported.

features.name: lower pipe run
features.measured: the back wall's lower run, two pipes with their shadow, y 884-912 from the wall box left of the desk (x 368) right past the desk; the outline taken to x 760, 110 px beyond the desk's mask

exceptions.why: Vega's desk stands in front of the lower pipe run, so the desk's outline must cross it: the run passes behind the desk's left end panel, where the outline also steps in round the wall box.
The run passes behind the desk's right end panel, as at its left.

features.name: upper pipe run
features.measured: the back wall's upper run, two pipes y 829-862, from the bend at x 455 right past the desk to x 760

exceptions.why: The upper run begins at the pipe bend behind the left-hand monitor: the monitor's outline crosses it there.
The upper run passes behind the right-hand monitor: the monitor's side edge crosses it, and the mask's step out to the desk's right end lies 21 px under it.
The clamp stands 39 px clear of the monitor's side, but its lower left corner is 8 px from the corner where the mask steps out to the desk's right end, which is set by the desk.

features.name: pipe bend, left
features.measured: the pipe bundle coming down from the back-wall junction box (its foot y 690) at x 434-478 and bending right into the upper run at y 835-863

exceptions.where: behind the left monitor and the desk's top
exceptions.why: The bundle comes down behind the left-hand monitor and turns into the upper run there: the monitor's top and the desk's outline cross it.

features.name: wall box, left of the desk
features.measured: x 369-441, y 850-897, with its rivets and shadow

exceptions.why: The box's right part is behind the desk's left end, so the desk's outline crosses it.

features.name: vertical pipe, left wall
features.measured: x 26-54, from the clamp at y 880 down past the crates' top

exceptions.why: The pipe runs down the left wall behind Atlas's crates: their top edge crosses it.
The clamp holds the vertical pipe just above the crates' top: its foot is about 12 px from their edge, which is set by the crates.

features.name: pipe, left wall top
features.measured: the horizontal pipe along the left wall's top, y 843-863, x 0-112

features.name: grille plate
features.measured: the riveted vent plate on the left wall, x 82-184, its top from (85, 897) to (178, 883), its foot about y 1040-1046

exceptions.why: Atlas's crates stand in front of the plate: their top edge crosses its upper band, up to 19 px of which stays above them.
The crates' right end stands 13 px from the plate's right edge: the edge is set by the crates.

features.name: locker bank
features.measured: the left wall's lockers, x 207-343, their foot from y 1038 at x 207 to 1002 at x 343

exceptions.why: The crates' right end stands 11 px from the lockers' left frame: the edge is set by the crates.
The crates stand in front of the lockers' lower left door: their top and right edges cross it and the bank's middle frame.
